Strong working knowledge of German GAAP (HGB), including preparation of Jahresabschluss. Direct experience managing or supporting German statutory audits (Wirtschaftsprüfung) and working with a Wirtschaftsprüfer. Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to clearly explain issues and solutions to upper management in both German and English. Preferred Wirtschaftsprüfer or Steuerberater qualification, or equivalent German accounting/tax credential. Master's degree in Accounting or Finance. Big 4 or mid-tier public accounting background in Germany. Experience supporting US or international accounting teams, ideally in a lead or team-lead capacity. Want to understand the why behind the way something is done and aren't afraid to make changes when you see a better way. Are motivated to carry projects through to completion and don't get derailed by small obstacles.
